name: PlexBlocks – CTA Section for Block Editor
author: ConicPlex

sections.description:
PlexBlocks – CTA Section for Block Editor helps you build marketing-ready Call-to-Action (CTA) sections directly inside the WordPress Gutenberg block editor. Instead of combining multiple separate blocks or depending on heavy third-party page builders, this single block provides a complete, high-converting CTA layout tailored for landing pages, product announcements, lead capture, and promo banners.

Key Features

  • 4 Built-in Design Presets: Quickly switch between Spotlight, Editorial, Dark Mode, and App Promo visual styles.
  • Flexible Layout Options: Choose from Split (side-by-side media and copy), Centered, Banner, and App Stack layouts.
  • Dual Action Buttons: Configure primary and secondary CTA buttons with individual links, labels, and target tab settings.
  • Media & Product Showcase: Display hero images, mockups, or illustrations alongside your copy with rounded, device frame, or circular shape styling.
  • Trust & Proof Bullets: Highlight key benefits, guarantees, or feature bullet points with polished visual icons.
  • Granular Style Controls: Adjust card background, border color, text color, accent highlights, border radius, padding, max width, and content gaps directly from the block sidebar.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built natively for Gutenberg using server-side rendering for clean HTML output and fast page load speeds.

Configuration & Usage

Configuring and using PlexBlocks – CTA Section for Block Editor is quick and intuitive:

  1. Adding the Block: Open any post or page in the block editor. Click the + block inserter icon, search for CTA Section, and select it (located in the PlexBlocks category). You can also type /cta in a new block line.
  2. Selecting a Design Preset: In the block inspector panel on the right sidebar, open the Content tab and choose a design preset (Spotlight, Editorial, Dark, or App Promo).
  3. Choosing a Layout: Select your preferred layout format:
    • Split: Displays copy on one side and showcase media on the other.
    • Centered: Centers copy and action buttons.
    • Banner: Creates a compact inline banner for quick callouts.
    • App Stack: Formats copy and media for app promo sections.
  4. Editing Copy & Details: Customize the text fields directly in the sidebar:
    • Eyebrow / Badge: Set a small pre-heading tag (e.g., “New Feature” or “Limited Offer”).
    • Heading & Body Text: Craft your main value proposition and body text.
    • Supporting Text: Add secondary context or pricing notes.
    • Feature List: Enter key highlights or trust points, one item per line.
  5. Setting Up Action Buttons: Under the Actions tab:
    • Configure Primary Button Label, Primary Button URL, and toggle whether to open in a new tab.
    • Configure optional Secondary Button Label, Secondary Button URL, and target settings.
  6. Adding Media: Under the Media tab:
    • Upload or select an image from your Media Library.
    • Choose a media shape (Rounded, Device Frame, or Circle) and set alt text.
  7. Customizing Styles: Under the Style tab:
    • Fine-tune visual appearance with controls for Card Background, Border Color, Text Color, Accent Color, Muted Color, Border Radius, Padding, Content Gap, and Max Width.

Developer Credits

This plugin was developed by ConicPlex, an agency specializing in WordPress block plugins and custom solutions. Learn more at ConicPlex.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to your site’s /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress Admin plugin uploader.
  2. Activate PlexBlocks – CTA Section for Block Editor through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any page or post in the block editor, click the + block inserter, and select CTA Section (under the PlexBlocks category).
sections.faq:
Can I use two action buttons in one CTA section?

Yes! You can configure both a primary CTA button (e.g., “Start Free Trial”) and a secondary CTA button (e.g., “Schedule Demo” or “Learn More”).

Do I need a page builder plugin to use this block?

No. The block runs natively inside the standard WordPress Gutenberg block editor and requires no external framework or builder.

Can I customize the colors and spacing to match my theme?

Absolutely. The block sidebar includes controls for background colors, border colors, accent tones, typography colors, padding, border radius, and content gaps.

How does the feature bullet list work?

Simply type your key points into the Feature List field in the sidebar, with one item per line. They will render automatically with stylish proof icons.
